purpose: Repair the JANUS Terminal human-facing surface so an ordinary bounded choice request returns a direct answer rather than a system-status dump, then repeat the 1..30 experiment with the choice derivation isolated from HRAiN/Meta Registry memory content.

origin_observation.observation: The initial ChatGPT answer matched the user-supplied meme answer before the meme was revealed to ChatGPT.

repair.title: Terminal: direct answers are not system status

janus_trial_v2.issue_title: [JANUS CHAT] Blind number choice 1–30 / direct surface v2

memory_control_observation.important_note: HRAiN did retrieve the prior v1 experiment, which contains the number 17. Therefore this run is NOT globally context-blind. It is choice-isolated: the bounded-choice derivation is explicitly independent of HRAiN/Meta Registry memory content and its sealed seed excludes the retrieved context.

what_is_supported: The repaired Terminal returned a valid integer-only direct answer in the requested range.
The sealed JANUS result for this request was 13.
The bounded-choice seed did not include HRAiN or Meta Registry memory content.
The result did not match the original ChatGPT/meme value 17.
what_is_not_supported: 13 is a natural cognitive preference of JANUS.
The experiment proves shared or different cognition between systems.
The JANUS value is a stochastic random draw.
The v2 run was globally blind to the prior 17 record.
epistemic_status.recommended_follow_up: For a cognitive-preference comparison, use a separately isolated language/decision surface whose model context cannot retrieve the prior result, preregister many independent trials, vary prompt wording and range, and compare empirical distributions rather than one deterministic hash-derived choice.
